description: The latest invoices, newest first, at most 12: period, status, total in cents with `display` as the amount to quote, currency, and whether it is the current draft. The current draft invoice has isDraft true; it is the only answer to "what will we be billed", and it is a draft that can still change. There is no forecast. Quote each total by its `display`; never add up or convert amounts. No PDF links. Use when: someone asks about invoices, spend or the next bill. Owner or billing admin only; other roles get 403. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this; an API key is refused.
name: listWorkspaceInvoices

outputSchema.description: The latest invoices, newest first, at most 12. The current draft has `isDraft` true. No PDF links.

display.description: The total as the Billing page writes it. Quote this.

title: List Invoices
